exposure: insertion of LNG 52 mg IUS at 2 weeks postpartum
cohort: Women interested in postpartum LNG IUS were recruited and received the device under ultrasound guidance at 14-20 days postpartum.
finding: Insertion of LNG IUS at 2 weeks postpartum was found to be feasible and acceptable to patients, with 93% of participants recommending it to a friend and an 86% continuation rate at 6 months postpartum.
